description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way .  
 
 Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong.  Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward. 
 
 What this job involves: 
 #JLLTechAmbitions — The JLL Technologies Software Engineering team brings successful technology products to market, accelerating technology adoption in commercial real estate and shaping the future of real estate for a better world. 
 We're looking for a capable Full Stack Developer to build and own features for a flagship CRE product across React, TanStack, Python, Django, and DRF — working independently from UI through API design, with growing ownership over what you build. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Independently design, build, and maintain front end and backend portions of features, tech debt, and bug fixes. 
 Build React UI using TanStack Query/Table/Router; design and implement DRF API endpoints. 
 Partner with PMs and developers to ideate features and scope technical approaches. 
 Improve existing systems, applying good security practices across the stack. 
 Write thorough unit/integration tests; review others' code with substantive feedback. 
 Deploy via runbook and help improve it; write technical documentation for owned features. 
 Use AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot) for implementation and test writing, validating all output. 
 
 Experience & Education 
 Undergraduate or higher degree in CS, Engineering, or relevant field, or equivalent experience. 
 3-5 years of experience as a full stack or front end-leaning developer using React. 
 Working experience with a backend framework; Python/Django strongly preferred. 
 Strong problem-solving skills; comfortable working through ambiguity on scoped features. 
 Experience in Agile environments; able to mentor junior engineers. 
 Technical Skills 
 Solid hands-on React experience: hooks, component architecture, state management. 
 Practical experience with TanStack Query, Table, and/or Router. 
 Working proficiency in Python, Django, and DRF for building and maintaining APIs. 
 Experience writing automated tests (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library, pytest). 
 Practical use of AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot), knowing when to verify output. 
 Nice to Have 
 CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployment (AWS, Azure) experience. 
 Exposure to performance profiling/optimization on React apps. 
 Familiarity with Docker and infrastructure basics. 
 
 What we can do for you: 
 You'll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where like-minded people succeed together across the globe. Our Total Rewards program supports your ambitions in career, recognition, well-being, benefits, and pay. Apply today! 
 
 Location: 
 
Remote –Jalisco,MEX 
 If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements.  We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
 
 
 At JLL, we harness the power of artificial intelligence (AI) to efficiently accelerate meaningful connections between candidates and opportunities. Using AI capabilities, we analyze your application for relevant skills, experiences, and qualifications to generate valuable insights about how your unique profile aligns with the specific requirements of the role you're pursuing.
 
 
 JLL Privacy Notice 
 Jones Lang LaSalle (JLL), together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading global provider of real estate and investment management services. We take our responsibility to protect the personal information provided to us seriously. Generally the personal information we collect from you are for the purposes of processing in connection with JLL’s recruitment process. We endeavour to keep your personal information secure with appropriate level of security and keep for as long as we need it for legitimate business or legal reasons. We will then delete it safely and securely.
 
 For more information about how JLL processes your personal data, please view our Candidate Privacy Statement .
 
 For additional details please see our career site pages for each country.
